site.title: Our Story
site.headline: A little surprise, now streaming.
site.subheadline: Three chapters, too many butterflies to count, and a little red-screen love story made just for us.

months.label: First Month
months.description: The first month where everything felt brand new, a little unreal, and way too cute to stay undocumented.
months.previewCaption: First smiles, first favorites, and the chapter that started the whole series.

months.label: Six Months
months.tagline: Christmas lights, dinner nights, and half a year
months.description: Six months in, the story got warmer: holiday keepsakes, a quiet temple moment, Indian dinner memories, and a chapter that already knows it is special.
months.status: Renewed, glowing, and still no skips
